description: Unit tests for the STTMuteFilter class, which filters audio and transcription frames based on different mute strategies, including first speech, always mute, function call triggers, and mute until the first bot complete. The tests utilize various frame classes, external strategy configurations, and a custom callback to verify the behavior of the mute filter logic in different scenarios.

classes.name: TestSTTMuteFilter
classes.description: A unittest IsolatedAsyncioTestCase class that contains multiple asynchronous test methods to verify the behavior of the STTMuteFilter under various strategies and conditions.

methods.name: test_first_speech_strategy(self)
methods.description: Tests the mute filter's behavior when configured with the FIRST_SPEECH strategy, verifying that frames before the first bot speech are suppressed.

methods.name: test_always_strategy(self)
methods.description: Tests the filter configured with the ALWAYS strategy, ensuring all frames are suppressed during mute.

methods.name: test_transcription_frames_with_always_strategy(self)
methods.description: Verifies that transcription frames are only passed through after the bot has finished speaking when using the ALWAYS strategy.

methods.name: test_function_call_strategy(self)
methods.description: Tests the filter with the FUNCTION_CALL strategy, ensuring frames associated with function call triggers are correctly handled.

methods.name: test_mute_until_first_bot_complete_strategy(self)
methods.description: Verifies the behavior when the filter mutes until the first bot speech completes, then unmutes.

methods.name: test_incompatible_strategies(self)
methods.description: Checks that using incompatible strategy combinations raises a ValueError.

methods.name: test_custom_strategy(self)
methods.description: Tests a custom mute callback that mutes or unmutes based on internal state, verifying flexible custom logic.
